title: Warm Creamy British Cheese Ploughmans Lunch
description: A traditional Yorkshire dish featuring a flaky puff pastry crust, creamy cheese filling, and tangy green salsa, all wrapped up in a cataplana vessel. This lacto-vegetarian friendly ploughmans lunch is perfect for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded cheese, green salsa, and melted butter until well combined.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg.
Spoon the cheese mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Place the pastry in a cataplana vessel and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pastry from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
